groups.why_chosen: One incident traced across four colour-coded subsystem boxes on a single stall/continue timeline, each region keeping its own lettered step count (B, H, X, L) instead of one global sequence.
groups.what_to_learn: Give each subsystem its own colour and its own lettered step count (B/H/X/L) instead of one global number, and draw the causal jump as one arrow crossing straight from the stalled thread's timeline into the box that resolves it.
